**Inputs:**
- Design spec: `.handoffs/sprint-5-design-spec.md` (16 linear steps; libraries: react-signature-canvas, @dnd-kit/sortable, react-markdown+rehype-sanitize, @react-pdf/renderer)
- Migration handoff: `.handoffs/sprint-5-dato-migration.md`
- Migration LIVE: `supabase/migrations/20260415000008_consent_forms.sql` (4 new tables: consent_form_templates, consent_form_submissions, consent_form_requests, reach_ink_records; 8 RPCs; RPC-ONLY writes for submissions; audit_hash via trigger; pgcrypto)
- Types updated: `lib/supabase/types.ts`

- DO touch: `app/(app)/consent-forms/*`, `app/consent/*` (public), `components/consent/*`, `components/appointments/ConsentStatus*`, `lib/consent/*`, `lib/pdf/consent-form.tsx`, `workers/jobs/generate-consent-pdf.ts`, `workers/cron/purge-consent-*.ts`, `app/api/consent-forms/*`, `app/api/consent-requests/*`, `app/api/public/consent/*`

- Do NOT create new migrations — Sprint 5 migration is done

**Sprint 5 scope — execute the 16-step build:**

1. **Consent forms hub** at `/consent-forms` — tabs Templates | Submissions (default Submissions). 
   - **Submissions**: DataTable with columns — signed_at, client name (joined via client_id), template name, booking link, signer_name, status dot (signed/expired/soft_deleted), actions (View PDF, Resend link, Soft delete). Filters: template, date range, client, booking. Bulk export zip of PDFs (use `jszip` or stream tar).
   - **Templates**: Grid of template cards — name + kind badge + version + # submissions + is_default badge. Actions: Edit, Duplicate, Archive, Preview. "+ New Template" CTA.

2. **Template builder** at `/consent-forms/templates/new` + `/consent-forms/templates/[id]/edit`:
   - Two-panel: LEFT palette + sortable section list, RIGHT live preview (read-only rendering).
   - Section palette: heading / paragraph / signature / checkbox / text / date / dropdown / file_upload / initials / ink_disclosure / reach_batch.
   - Inline section edit: label, body (markdown), required toggle, validation.
   - `@dnd-kit/sortable` for reorder.
   - Top bar: template name, kind select, retention_years (default 7), is_default toggle, language (en/es/fr/de/nl), required_for_booking toggle, requires_guardian toggle.
   - "Preview as client" modal using current in-editor state.
   - "Start from template" dropdown with 5 seeded defaults (tattoo / piercing / PMU / touch-up / minor). Create seed templates on studio onboarding OR on first visit to templates tab (idempotent).
   - Saving: metadata-only changes update in place; any section change creates a new version (migration trigger enforces immutability — catch `P0001` exception → prompt "This creates a new version v{n+1}. Confirm?").

3. **Public consent signing** at `/consent/[token]` — NO auth, mobile-first, isolated layout `app/consent/layout.tsx`:
   - Inject `--studio-brand-color` as CSS var from studio lookup.
   - Zero InkOS chrome — studio logo + brand only.
   - Fetch request via `/api/public/consent/requests/[token]` which calls `get_consent_request` RPC (flips status to 'opened').
   - Render each section in order via `ConsentSectionRenderer` component switching on type.
   - Signature sections use `react-signature-canvas` — min 3 strokes + 20 total points validation.
   - Progress indicator (X of Y sections complete).
   - localStorage key `inkos:consent:${token}:progress` — save on each section complete, clear on successful submit.
   - "Sign and submit" CTA disabled until all required filled.
   - Submit POSTs to `/api/public/consent/submit` which calls `submit_consent_form` RPC (server-side uploads signature PNG to storage using service-role client at deterministic path).
   - On 200 → success state with "Download your copy" PDF link (PDF async, link polls until ready).
   - If template `requires_guardian`: second signature pad + guardian name/relationship fields.
   - REACH ink disclosure sections: display-only on client side (artist fills batch numbers post-session from internal view).

4. **Signature pad component** `components/consent/SignaturePad.tsx`:
   - `react-signature-canvas` wrapper, ink-black bg, white stroke, smooth.
   - "Clear" + "Done" buttons.
   - Validation: 3 strokes + 20 points minimum.
   - Touch + mouse + stylus (inherits from react-signature-canvas).
   - Captures: PNG (toDataURL) + SVG path from raw points.
   - Mobile: auto-fit to container width, keyboard-aware (push signature pad up when other inputs focused).

5. **Submission view** at `/consent-forms/submissions/[id]` (authed):
   - Renders from `template_snapshot` jsonb (NOT current template) + answers.
   - Signature image preview (signed URL from storage).
   - Audit card: signed_at, IP, user agent, geo country, audit_hash (truncated + copy full), template version, expires_at countdown.
   - PDF download (signed URL 1hr).
   - Guardian signature section if present.
   - REACH ink records — inline editable by artist post-session (add batch numbers, ink brand/color, manufacture/expiry dates). API route `POST /api/consent-forms/submissions/[id]/reach-records`.
   - Actions: Resend PDF to client (enqueue email job), Soft delete (owner-only).

6. **Public signed-form view** at `/consent/view/[consentToken]`:
   - Anon, clean printable layout, watermark "Signed copy" + studio name.
   - Fetch via `/api/public/consent/view/[token]` → `view_consent_submission` RPC.
   - Download PDF CTA.

7. **Send consent request** — from booking detail page (Sprint 2). New button "Send consent form" (shown when `bookings.consent_required=true AND consent_submission_id IS NULL`). Modal: template select (filter active, matching service), channel (email/sms/both), editable message preview. Submit calls `POST /api/consent-requests` → `initiate_consent_request` RPC → enqueues Resend/Twilio email via BullMQ. Appointment detail shows consent status badge: Pending / Opened / Signed with mini-timeline.

8. **Pending consent alerts** — Dashboard KPI card "Bookings missing consent" with link. Filter chip in `/appointments` list: "Missing consent". Server-side query via `list_pending_consent_bookings` RPC.

9. **Auto-send consent on booking** — add toggle to `booking_page_settings`: "Auto-send consent form after booking" per kind. Enforce on booking INSERT via worker job (not trigger — workers can send email via Resend): when `bookings.consent_required=true` AND `source='public'`, enqueue `initiate_consent_request` + email.

10. **PDF generation worker** `workers/jobs/generate-consent-pdf.ts`:
    - Uses `@react-pdf/renderer` in the worker (NOT in Next.js — renderer has DOM deps that crash in Node; use the worker variant).
    - Template: `lib/pdf/consent-form.tsx` — studio logo top, template title, sections rendered in order with answers, signatures embedded (PNG from storage), audit metadata footer.
    - Writes to `consent-forms` bucket at path `{studio_id}/{submission_id}/form.pdf`.
    - Updates `consent_form_submissions.pdf_path` + `pdf_generated_at`.
    - Submission view polls `GET /api/consent-forms/submissions/[id]` every 2s until `pdf_path !== null`.

11. **Cron jobs** `workers/cron/purge-expired-consents.ts` + `purge-soft-deleted-consents.ts`:
    - Weekly schedule.
    - First: soft-delete submissions where `expires_at < now()` AND `soft_deleted_at IS NULL`.
    - Second: hard-delete submissions (+ storage files via service-role) where `soft_deleted_at < now() - interval '90 days'`.
    - Both log audit actions.

12. **Retention UX** — Template card: "Signed forms auto-delete after {retention_years} years (GDPR)". Submission view: countdown badge + "Request early deletion" action (GDPR right to erasure — calls soft delete RPC).

13. **API routes to create** (all authed unless public, session-derived studio, `authedRatelimit`, Zod):
    - `/api/consent-forms/templates` GET/POST
    - `/api/consent-forms/templates/[id]` GET/PATCH/DELETE (DELETE = archive)
    - `/api/consent-forms/templates/[id]/duplicate` POST
    - `/api/consent-forms/templates/[id]/preview` GET (returns rendered preview HTML)
    - `/api/consent-forms/submissions` GET (list + filters)
    - `/api/consent-forms/submissions/[id]` GET/PATCH (soft_delete only)
    - `/api/consent-forms/submissions/[id]/resend` POST
    - `/api/consent-forms/submissions/[id]/reach-records` GET/POST/DELETE
    - `/api/consent-forms/submissions/bulk-export` GET (zip stream)
    - `/api/consent-forms/pending` GET (uses RPC)
    - `/api/consent-requests` POST
    - `/api/consent-requests/[id]` GET/DELETE
    - `/api/consent-requests/[id]/resend` POST

14. **Public API routes** (anon, rate-limited, use `lib/supabase/public.ts`):
    - `/api/public/consent/requests/[token]` GET (calls `get_consent_request` RPC)
    - `/api/public/consent/submit` POST (Zod-parse body incl. base64 signature PNG, calls `submit_consent_form` RPC)
    - `/api/public/consent/view/[consentToken]` GET (calls `view_consent_submission` RPC)
    - Rate limits: reads 20/min per IP, submit 3/min per IP.

15. **Shared components (create):**
    - `components/consent/templates/TemplatesGrid.tsx`, `TemplateCard.tsx`
    - `components/consent/templates/TemplateBuilder.tsx`, `SectionPalette.tsx`, `SectionList.tsx`, `SectionEditor.tsx`, `TemplatePreview.tsx`
    - `components/consent/templates/SectionRenderer.tsx` (for preview — polymorphic by section type)
    - `components/consent/public/PublicSignFlow.tsx`, `ProgressIndicator.tsx`, `SubmitButton.tsx`, `SuccessState.tsx`
    - `components/consent/SignaturePad.tsx`
    - `components/consent/submissions/SubmissionsTable.tsx`, `SubmissionView.tsx`, `AuditCard.tsx`, `ReachInkEditor.tsx`
    - `components/consent/ConsentStatusBadge.tsx` (for appointment detail)
    - `components/consent/SendConsentRequestModal.tsx` (for appointment detail)
    - `components/consent/RetentionCountdown.tsx`

16. **Validation** — all 4 gates: `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test`.

**Dependencies to install:**
- `react-signature-canvas` + `@types/react-signature-canvas`
- `@dnd-kit/core` + `@dnd-kit/sortable` + `@dnd-kit/utilities` (if not already from Sprint 3)
- `react-markdown` + `rehype-sanitize`
- `@react-pdf/renderer`
- `jszip` (for bulk export)

**Section JSON schema** (already in design spec, restate for Koda reference):
```ts
type SectionType = 'heading'|'paragraph'|'signature'|'checkbox'|'text'|'date'|'dropdown'|'file_upload'|'initials'|'ink_disclosure'|'reach_batch';
interface Section {
  id: string; // uuid
  type: SectionType;
  label: string;
  body?: string; // markdown for paragraph/heading/ink_disclosure
  required: boolean;
  options?: string[]; // dropdown
  placeholder?: string; // text
  validation?: { minLength?: number; maxLength?: number; pattern?: string };
}
```

**Hard rules:**
- Zero `any`, zero `console.log`, zero raw hex outside brand swatch
- Zero direct INSERT into `consent_form_submissions` (migration blocks it via RLS — RPC only)
- All mutations → Sonner toast
- Public routes use `lib/supabase/public.ts` (never session client)
- Signature base64 PNG is user input — validate MIME + size (max 500KB) + base64 shape before passing to RPC
- Template version immutability: catch `P0001` on update → show "Creates new version" confirmation modal
- `template_snapshot` jsonb frozen at sign time — submission view never re-joins to current template
- Markdown: `react-markdown` + `rehype-sanitize` allowlist (no `<script>`, no dangerous tags)
- PDF generation happens in worker, NOT web service (react-pdf in Next.js breaks build)
- base-nova `render` not `asChild`
- CSS `group-data-[collapsible=icon]:*` for sidebar
- Mobile-first for public signing
- localStorage used only for draft recovery; clear on successful submit

**Deliverables:**
1. All 4 gates green
2. `.handoffs/sprint-5-build-report.md` with file inventory, deviations, stubs, acceptance criteria
3. Short summary: file counts, blockers

Do NOT touch Sprint 6+ scope.

1	# Sprint 5 Dato Migration Handoff — Digital Consent Forms
2	
3	**Migration:** `supabase/migrations/20260415000008_consent_forms.sql`
4	**Date:** 2026-04-15
5	
6	---
7	
8	## Table Inventory
9	
10	| Table | Ownership | RLS Scope | Realtime | Notes |
11	|-------|-----------|-----------|---------|-------|
12	| `consent_form_templates` | `studio_id` | `user_studio_ids()` | No | Immutable once submissions reference it |
13	| `consent_form_submissions` | `studio_id` | `user_studio_ids()` — read only | No | No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policy — RPC-only writes |
14	| `consent_form_requests` | `studio_id` | `user_studio_ids()` | No | Owner/admin-only DELETE |
15	| `reach_ink_records` | `studio_id` | `user_studio_ids()` | No | Owner/admin-only DELETE |
16	| `bookings` (extended) | existing | existing | existing | 3 new columns added |
17	
18	---
19	
20	## New Columns on `bookings`
21	
22	```sql
23	consent_required      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
24	consent_submission_id uuid REFERENCES consent_form_submissions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
25	consent_signed_at     timestamptz
26	```
27	
28	**Index:** `bookings_consent_pending` — partial index on `(studio_id, scheduled_at)` where `consent_required = true AND consent_submission_id IS NULL AND status IN ('confirmed','pending')`.
29	
30	---
31	
32	## RPC Contracts
33	
34	### Anon-safe (grant to `anon` + `authenticated`)
35	
36	**`get_consent_template_by_slug(p_studio_slug text, p_template_slug text) RETURNS jsonb`**
37	- Returns active template sections for client-side form rendering.
38	- Does NOT return audit_hash, ip_address, or any submission data.
39	- Returns null if studio/template combo not found or template inactive.
40	
41	**`get_consent_request(p_token uuid) RETURNS jsonb`**
42	- Validates token, returns request + template sections + minimal client/booking data.
43	- Side effect: flips status `pending` → `opened` and sets `opened_at` on first call.
44	- Returns `{error: 'request_not_found' | 'already_signed' | 'request_cancelled' | 'request_expired'}` on failure.
45	
46	**`submit_consent_form(p_request_token, p_answers, p_signature_png_base64, p_signer_name, p_signer_email, p_signer_phone, p_signer_dob, p_guardian, p_ink_records) RETURNS jsonb`**
47	- The single atomic consent submission endpoint.
48	- Returns `{consent_token, submission_id, signature_path, guardian_path, view_url, status: 'signed'}` on success.
49	- Returns `{error: 'already_signed' | 'expired' | 'request_cancelled' | 'request_not_found' | 'submission_failed'}` on failure.
50	- **IMPORTANT for Koda:** This RPC returns `signature_path` and `guardian_path` — the API route MUST upload the base64 PNG to Supabase Storage at those exact paths using the service-role client BEFORE calling this RPC (or immediately after — path is deterministic). The RPC records the path but does not write to storage itself (Postgres cannot write to Supabase Storage objects).
51	
52	**`view_consent_submission(p_consent_token uuid) RETURNS jsonb`**
53	- Public shareable view — returns template_snapshot, answers, signer_name, signed_at, pdf_path.
54	- DOES NOT return: audit_hash, ip_address, user_agent, guardian_signature_path.
55	- Returns null if token invalid or submission soft-deleted.
56	
57	### Authenticated-only
58	
59	**`list_pending_consent_bookings(p_studio_id uuid) RETURNS SETOF jsonb`**
60	- Returns bookings where `consent_required = true AND consent_submission_id IS NULL AND status IN ('confirmed','pending')`.
61	- Verifies caller belongs to the studio via `user_studio_ids()`.
62	
63	**`initiate_consent_request(p_booking_id uuid, p_template_id uuid, p_channel text) RETURNS jsonb`**
64	- `p_channel IN ('email','sms','both')`.
65	- Creates a `consent_form_requests` row, returns `{request_id, request_token, view_url, sent_to_email, sent_to_phone, status: 'created'}`.
66	- If an active (non-expired) request already exists for this booking+template, returns `{request_token, view_url, status: 'existing'}` — no duplicate.
67	- The returned `view_url` is passed to the email/SMS worker queue for sending.
68	
69	**`soft_delete_consent_submission(p_submission_id uuid) RETURNS boolean`**
70	- Owner/admin only. Sets `soft_deleted_at = now()`.
71	- Returns `true` if deleted, `false` if not found / unauthorized.
72	- Hard deletion happens via `purge-soft-deleted-consents` cron after 90-day grace.
73	
74	---
75	
76	## Section Shape Spec
77	
78	Every element in `consent_form_templates.sections` (JSONB array) follows this shape:
79	
80	```typescript
81	type ConsentSection = {
82	  id: string                          // uuid — stable identifier for answers keying
83	  type:
84	    | 'heading'
85	    | 'paragraph'
86	    | 'signature'
87	    | 'initials'
88	    | 'checkbox'
89	    | 'text'
90	    | 'date'
91	    | 'dropdown'
92	    | 'file_upload'
93	    | 'ink_disclosure'                // free-text ink acknowledgment
94	    | 'reach_batch'                   // triggers reach_ink_records row on submit
95	  label: string
96	  body?: string                       // markdown allowed (paragraphs, headings)
97	  required?: boolean
98	  options?: string[]                  // dropdown / radio
99	  placeholder?: string                // text inputs
100	  validation?: {
101	    min?: number
102	    max?: number
103	    pattern?: string
104	  }
105	}
106	```
107	
108	`answers` in `consent_form_submissions` is keyed by `section.id`:
109	- checkbox: `boolean`
110	- text / date: `string`
111	- dropdown: `string` (one of `options`)
112	- signature / initials: storage path (populated by submit RPC)
113	- reach_batch: object matching reach_ink_records columns
114	
115	---
116	
117	## audit_hash Algorithm
118	
119	```
120	canonical_string = template_snapshot::text
121	                 || answers::text
122	                 || signature_path
123	                 || signer_name
124	                 || signed_at::text
125	
126	audit_hash = encode(digest(canonical_string, 'sha256'), 'hex')
127	```
128	
129	Computed server-side by `compute_consent_audit_hash()` SECURITY DEFINER function (uses pgcrypto `digest()`). Called by the post-insert trigger on `consent_form_submissions`. Never client-supplied.
130	
131	**Verification at read time:**
132	```sql
133	SELECT compute_consent_audit_hash(
134	  id, template_snapshot, answers, signature_path, signer_name, signed_at
135	) = audit_hash AS is_untampered
136	FROM consent_form_submissions
137	WHERE id = $1;
138	```
139	
140	---
141	
142	## EU REACH Schema Mapping
143	
144	`reach_ink_records` maps to EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 §2(d) cosmetic ingredient traceability requirements for tattoo inks:
145	
146	| `reach_ink_records` column | REACH requirement |
147	|---------------------------|-------------------|
148	| `ink_brand` | Manufacturer identity |
149	| `ink_color` | Colorant identity |
150	| `ink_product_code` | Product reference number |
151	| `batch_number` | Batch/lot identifier (mandatory) |
152	| `manufacture_date` | Production date |
153	| `expiry_date` | Shelf life / use-by date |
154	| `reach_compliant` | Confirmation ink meets REACH Annex XVII restrictions |
155	| `sds_url` | Safety Data Sheet URL (mandatory for REACH §31) |
156	
157	One `reach_ink_records` row per ink per session. Multiple inks → multiple rows all linked to the same `submission_id` and `booking_id`.
158	
159	---
160	
161	## GDPR Retention Timeline
162	
163	```
164	Day 0:        Consent signed (consent_form_submissions row created)
165	              expires_at = signed_at + retention_years (template default: 7 years)
166	
167	Year 7:       expires_at < now()
168	              Weekly cron 'purge-expired-consents' sets soft_deleted_at = now()
169	
170	Year 7 + 90d: soft_deleted_at < now() - interval '90 days'
171	              Weekly cron 'purge-soft-deleted-consents' hard-DELETEs the row
172	              Associated reach_ink_records CASCADE deleted
173	              Signature PNG in consent-forms bucket must be deleted separately
174	              by the cron worker using service-role storage client
175	
176	Manual GDPR erasure request:
177	              Studio owner calls soft_delete_consent_submission(id)
178	              → soft_deleted_at = now()
179	              → Cron hard-deletes 90 days later
180	              PII fields can be anonymized immediately if required by law:
181	              UPDATE consent_form_submissions SET
182	                signer_name = '[DELETED]', signer_email = NULL,
183	                signer_phone = NULL, signer_dob = NULL,
184	                guardian_name = NULL, answers = '{}',
185	                soft_deleted_at = now()
186	              WHERE id = $1;
187	```
188	
189	---
190	
191	## Storage — consent-forms Bucket
192	
193	**Bucket config (updated in migration):**
194	- `public = false` (private)
195	- `file_size_limit = 10485760` (10MB)
196	- `allowed_mime_types = ['image/png','image/jpeg','image/heic','application/pdf']`
197	
198	**Path convention:**
199	```
200	{studio_id}/{submission_id}/signature.png     ← signer signature
201	{studio_id}/{submission_id}/guardian.png      ← guardian signature (minor consent)
202	{studio_id}/{submission_id}/form.pdf          ← generated PDF (worker populates)
203	{studio_id}/{submission_id}/reach_{n}.pdf     ← REACH SDS attachments (optional)
204	```
205	
206	**Access pattern:**
207	- Studio members: authenticated SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE via storage policies (folder-prefix check)
208	- Public signing: API route uses service-role client to upload signature after `submit_consent_form` RPC returns the deterministic path. No direct anon storage grant.
209	- PDF generation worker (Railway): uses service-role key, updates `pdf_path` + `pdf_generated_at` via direct Supabase admin call after generating.
210	
211	---
212	
213	## Template Versioning + Immutability
214	
215	**Core rule:** Once any `consent_form_submissions` row references a template at a given version, that template version is FROZEN. The trigger `enforce_consent_template_immutability` RAISES EXCEPTION on any attempt to change `sections`, `name`, `kind`, `language`, `requires_guardian`, or `retention_years`.
216	
217	**To update a template:** Create a NEW row with `version = old_version + 1`, same `studio_id` + `slug`. The `UNIQUE(studio_id, slug, version)` constraint enforces this. Set `is_active = true` on the new version, `is_active = false` on the old.
218	
219	**Koda note:** The template builder UI must show a "Publish New Version" button, not a "Save" button, whenever any submission exists for the current version. Use the immutability error code `'P0001'` to detect this in the API route and surface the correct UX prompt.
220	
221	---
222	
223	## Koda Gotchas
224	
225	1. **RPC-only writes to submissions.** The `consent_form_submissions` table has NO INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies for `authenticated` or `anon`. Every write goes through the `submit_consent_form` SECURITY DEFINER RPC. Attempting `.from('consent_form_submissions').insert(...)` from client code will return 403.
226	
227	2. **Signature upload is decoupled from the DB insert.** The `submit_consent_form` RPC takes `p_signature_png_base64` as a parameter but records only the storage PATH in the DB. The API route calling this RPC MUST:
228	   a. Receive the base64 PNG from the client form
229	   b. Upload it to `consent-forms` bucket at path `{studio_id}/{submission_id}/signature.png` using service-role storage client
230	   c. Call `submit_consent_form` with the base64 value (or pass it and let the RPC handle just the path)
231	   The migration comment clarifies: pg cannot safely write to Supabase storage.objects. The API route owns the upload.
232	
233	3. **`expires_at` and `audit_hash` are trigger-computed.** Do NOT set them in Insert calls. They will be NULL immediately after insert and populated by the post-insert trigger within the same transaction.
234	
235	4. **Template default logic.** Setting `is_default = true` on a template automatically sets `is_default = false` on any previous default for the same `(studio_id, kind)` — this is handled by the `manage_consent_template_default` trigger. No app-level logic needed.
236	
237	5. **consent_token vs request_token.** Two distinct tokens:
238	   - `request_token` (on `consent_form_requests`) — UUID sent to the client before signing. Used for `/consent/{token}` page.
239	   - `consent_token` (on `consent_form_submissions`) — UUID generated at signing time. Used for `/consent/view/{token}` public shareable link.

/**

 * Called idempotently on first visit to the Templates tab.
 * Uses upsert — safe to call multiple times.
 */
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import type { Database } from '@/lib/supabase/types'
import type { ConsentSection } from '@/types/consent'

type DbClient = SupabaseClient<Database>

  slug: string
  name: string
  kind: 'tattoo' | 'piercing' | 'pmu' | 'touch_up' | 'minor'
  sections: ConsentSection[]

  retention_years: number

}

By initialling this section, you confirm you have reviewed this information and consent to their use.', order: 5 },

    { id: 'sec_sig', kind: 'signature', label: 'Client signature', signer: 'client', required: true, order: 8 },

function makePiercingSections(): ConsentSection[] {
  return [
    { id: 'sec_h1', kind: 'heading', label: 'Piercing Consent Form', level: 1, required: false, order: 0 },

    { id: 'sec_sig_guardian', kind: 'signature', label: "Guardian's signature", signer: 'guardian', required: true, order: 8 },
  ]
}

const SEED_TEMPLATES: SeedTemplate[] = [
  { slug: 'standard-tattoo', name: 'Standard Tattoo Consent', kind: 'tattoo', sections: makeTattooSections(), is_default: true, retention_years: 7, requires_guardian: false },
  { slug: 'standard-piercing', name: 'Standard Piercing Consent', kind: 'piercing', sections: makePiercingSections(), is_default: true, retention_years: 7, requires_guardian: false },
  { slug: 'standard-pmu', name: 'Permanent Makeup (PMU) Consent', kind: 'pmu', sections: makePMUSections(), is_default: true, retention_years: 7, requires_guardian: false },
  { slug: 'standard-touch-up', name: 'Touch-Up Consent', kind: 'touch_up', sections: makeTouchUpSections(), is_default: true, retention_years: 7, requires_guardian: false },
  { slug: 'minor-consent', name: 'Minor Consent (Under 18)', kind: 'minor', sections: makeMinorSections(), is_default: true, retention_years: 7, requires_guardian: true },
]

/**
 * Seed all 5 default templates for a studio.
 * Idempotent — uses upsert on (studio_id, slug, version).
 */
export async function seedDefaultTemplates(
  supabase: DbClient,
  studioId: string,
  createdBy: string
): Promise<void> {
  const rows = SEED_TEMPLATES.map((t) => ({
    studio_id: studioId,
    slug: t.slug,
    name: t.name,
    kind: t.kind,
    version: 1,
    is_active: true,
    is_default: t.is_default,
    sections: t.sections as unknown as Database['public']['Tables']['consent_form_templates']['Insert']['sections'],
    required_for_booking: false,
    requires_guardian: t.requires_guardian,
    retention_years: t.retention_years,
    language: 'en',
    created_by: createdBy,
  }))

  const { error } = await supabase
    .from('consent_form_templates')
    .upsert(rows, { onConflict: 'studio_id,slug,version', ignoreDuplicates: true })

  if (error) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to seed consent templates: ${error.message}`)
  }
}

/**
 * Check whether seed templates already exist for a studio.
 */
export async function hasSeededTemplates(
  supabase: DbClient,
  studioId: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  const { count } = await supabase
    .from('consent_form_templates')
    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .eq('studio_id', studioId)

  return (count ?? 0) > 0
}
